'''July 2001 Seattle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Broken Games, Seattle, WA on 21 July 2001. [[Nick Jones]] won it. It is known from Keith Watabayashi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2678">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-21-seattle-wa-7-21-01d2678/ seattle-wa-7-21-01], DeckTech (Keith "Gen" Watabayashi, 21 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-21-seattle-wa-7-21-01d2678/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Broken Games, Seattle, WA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Nick Jones]]
